ownAccessOnlyHint: Logins and roles of your club.
pageHint: Who may sign in and with which roles. You maintain the people themselves under «Members».

emptyState.title: Only your own access
emptyState.description: Invite more people and assign them a role: Admin, Writer, Treasurer or Reader.

explainRolesDescription: Each account can have several roles and receives all of their permissions. Roles are managed under “Roles”.
userModalDescription: Name, login and roles. Joining, leaving and templates are maintained under «Members».
passwordHelpEdit: Only fill in to change the password. At least 12 characters.
passwordHelpCreate: Required only for login. At least 12 characters.
enableLoginDescription: Easiest by invitation: the person sets their own password.

roleDescriptions.admin: Full access within the club, including structure (templates, cycles, settings), members, logins and roles.
roleDescriptions.writer: Works in the protocol area and maintains operational data, but changes neither structure nor finances.
roleDescriptions.kassier: Like reader, plus full write access to finances and fines.
roleDescriptions.reader: Read-only access, can trigger PDF exports and only sees their own fines.

toasts.deleteConfirm: Permanently delete «{name}»? The person disappears together with attendance, fines and tasks.
toasts.inviteFailed: The invitation could not be sent.

emptyWithoutLogin: All members already have a login.
enableLoginInactive: Inactive people cannot get a login. Activate them under «Members» first.
rolesHelp: An account can have several roles and gets all their permissions. You cannot assign roles with permissions you do not have yourself.
loginHelp: With a login the person can sign in and sees what their roles allow. Without one they remain a member (attendance, fines, tasks). Best invite by email instead of setting a password.
loginActive: Login active (untick to revoke the login)
loginSetPassword: Enable login with a password you set
passwordHelpSet: At least 12 characters. Share it with the person securely; they can change it in their profile afterwards.

blockers.displayName: Saving is disabled: the display name is missing.
blockers.email: Saving is disabled: a login needs an email address.
blockers.password: Saving is disabled: the password needs at least 12 characters.
blockers.tenant: Saving is disabled: choose a tenant.

loginMode.label: How does the person get the login?
loginMode.inviteHelp: The person receives a link (valid for 7 days) and sets their own password. The login becomes active once they accept.
loginMode.mailOff: Email sending is not set up, so no invitation is possible. Set a password and share it with the person securely.

revokeLogin.confirmMessage: {name} can no longer sign in afterwards; running sessions end immediately. The person remains a member with attendance, fines and tasks. You can delete them completely under «Members».
revokeLogin.failed: The login could not be revoked
